title: M. avium complex as a named NTM pack
dek: Wikipedia's MAC page is the avium/intracellulare (and friends) pack. Not MTBC. Not HRZE by default.
story: Mycobacterium avium complex on Wikipedia is a pack of related slow-growing NTM (avium, intracellulare, chimaera in many modern splits). Disseminated MAC in advanced HIV and nodular-bronchiectatic lung disease are the celebrity syndromes.
A TB lab's failure mode is a MAC bottle reported with a TB catalogue. Xpert should usually stay negative; if someone typed 'TB' from AFB alone, this node is the correction.
Treatment is macrolide-based NTM therapy in IDSA-ish land, not WHO HRZE. No doses on this glossary card.
deep: M. chimaera heater-cooler outbreak stories are why speciation inside MAC sometimes matters.
Heat-stable MAC in water systems is environmental, not a person-to-person TB outbreak until proven otherwise.
IGRA RD1 should usually ignore MAC; TST might not.

visual.caption: MAC as an NTM pack, not an MTBC lineage. Syndromes are why people search the name.
